cohort: 1306 patients undergoing cervical cancer surgery were enrolled, with 1101 in the analytic cohort and 205 in the external validation cohort.
finding: Diabetes mellitus, wound healing classification, presurgery radio/chemotherapy, postoperative urinary infection, use of analgesia pumps, and pain numerical rating score were identified as significant factors influencing postoperative urinary retention, and a predictive model based on these factors showed good predictive power.
mod_finding: History of caesarean section was identified as a potential influencing factor for postoperative urinary retention in univariate analysis.
